---
title: "Subset RateMyProfessor.com student star/difficulty data"
output: html_notebook
---

For Spearman's rho correlation.

[Data downloaded from He (2020)](https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/fvtfjyvw7d/2){target="_blank"}.

This notebook subsets that full dataset for only the columns

- `student_difficult`: students' difficulty rating of the given instructor (1 to 5, integers only)
- `student_star`: students' difficulty rating of the given instructor (1 to 5, half stars also possible)

```{r}
rmp_data <- read_csv('RateMyProfessor_Sample data.csv') |>
  select(student_star, student_difficult) |>
  drop_na()

write_csv(rmp_data, 'ratemyprof_stars.csv')
```

```{r eval=F}
cor.test(
  rmp_data$student_difficult,
  rmp_data$student_star,
  method = 'spearman'
)

# raises warning bc of "tied ranks" but nbd
```
